round_start_1.ogg.text: [exhales] Okay... here we go again. Stay sharp, everybody!

round_start_2.ogg.text: [determined] Lights are up, gates are shut. Let's see what crawls out tonight.

round_start_3.ogg.text: [tense] Here they come. Here they come! Hold the line!

round_start_4.ogg.text: Alright, round's on. Don't get cocky, and don't get dead.

round_start_5.ogg.text: [muttering] Oh, great. More of 'em. Of course there's more of 'em.

round_clear_1.ogg.text: [breathing hard] Phew... okay, okay. [tired laugh] Gotta catch my breath real quick, man. These things just don't quit!

round_clear_2.ogg.text: [sighs] Alright... that's the last of 'em. For now. Everybody still breathing? Tell me everybody's still breathing.

round_clear_3.ogg.text: [relieved laugh] Heh, still standing. Barely, but still standing. Let's patch that fence while we can.

round_clear_4.ogg.text: [exhales slowly] Quiet. Too quiet. I don't trust it, but I'll take it. Load up, people.

round_clear_5.ogg.text: [tired] Oh man, my hands are shaking. Okay. Okay, breathe. Next one's gonna be worse, isn't it?

reload_4.ogg.text: Gotta reload, gotta reload, hold 'em off!

reload_5.ogg.text: [breathing hard] Reloading... come on, come on.

reload_8.ogg.text: Hang on, just a sec, reloading!

reload_9.ogg.text: [muttering] Come on, come on, load, you stupid thing.

low_ammo_1.ogg.text: [worried] I'm running low here, almost out!

low_ammo_2.ogg.text: Ammo's getting thin, man. Don't waste any.

low_ammo_4.ogg.text: Ah, jeez, I'm nearly dry over here!

low_ammo_5.ogg.text: [tense] Low on ammo! Anybody got a spare mag?

dry_3.ogg.text: [panicked] Come on, come on... nothing! I'm outta ammo!

dry_4.ogg.text: Ah, damn it, empty! Switching, switching!

dry_5.ogg.text: [groans] Of course. Of course it's empty.

kill_6.ogg.text: [through gritted teeth] And stay dead this time.

streak_1.ogg.text: [excited, shouting] HA! Get some! [laughs] Come on, who's next?! I got plenty more where that came from!

streak_2.ogg.text: [shouting] Yeah! Yeah! That's what I'm talking about! Who else wants some?!

streak_3.ogg.text: [laughs] Look at 'em drop! Come on, don't be shy, line up!

streak_4.ogg.text: [excited] Whoo! I'm on fire here! Nobody touch my spot!

streak_5.ogg.text: [panting, grinning] Ha ha! Keep 'em coming! I'm just getting warmed up!

streak_6.ogg.text: [shouting] Boom! Boom! Boom! Is that all you've got?!

streak_7.ogg.text: [breathless laugh] Oh, that felt good. Do that again, do that again!

close_call_1.ogg.text: [gasps] Whoa! Too close, way too close!

close_call_2.ogg.text: [breathing hard] Jeez, that one nearly had me. Back off, back off!

close_call_3.ogg.text: Okay, I'm hurt, I'm hurt, I need a second here!

close_call_4.ogg.text: [strained] I can't take much more of this. Watch my back, somebody!

close_call_5.ogg.text: [shaky] Oh, that's not good, that's not good at all.

hurt_7.ogg.text: [groans in pain] Ah, son of a... ugh!

downed_1.ogg.text: [weak, gasping] No... no, no... I'm down... somebody... help...

downed_2.ogg.text: [groaning, wheezing] Aah... I can't get up. Help me. Please!

downed_3.ogg.text: [faint] Not like this... not like this...

downed_4.ogg.text: [pained, fading] I'm hit bad... somebody get me up...

revived_1.ogg.text: [gasping, coughing] Thanks, man. Thanks. I owe you one.

revived_2.ogg.text: [breathing hard] Whoa... okay, I'm up. I'm up. Good looking out!

revived_3.ogg.text: [coughs] Jeez, I thought that was it for me. Thanks for the pull!

revived_4.ogg.text: [wheezing] Oh, man. Thank you. Seriously. Let's go, let's go!

revived_5.ogg.text: [groans, then laughs weakly] You came back for me. Heh. I won't forget that.

teammate_down_1.ogg.text: [shouting] Man down! We got somebody down!

teammate_down_2.ogg.text: Oh no, no, they're down! Somebody get over there!

teammate_down_3.ogg.text: [urgent] Hang on, I'm coming! Hold on!

teammate_down_4.ogg.text: [alarmed] They got one of us! I'm going in, cover me!

teammate_down_5.ogg.text: Stay with me, stay with me! I'll get you up!

buy_weapon_1.ogg.text: [pleased] Oh, now we're talking. Come to papa.

buy_weapon_2.ogg.text: Ha, that's more like it. Let's see what this baby can do.

buy_weapon_3.ogg.text: [impressed] Nice. Real nice. Feels good in my hands.

buy_weapon_4.ogg.text: Alright, that's a proper piece. Let's put it to work.

buy_big_1.ogg.text: [excited] Oh, that cost a fortune, but boy, it's worth every penny!

buy_big_2.ogg.text: [laughs] Spent it all! Hope this thing's as good as it looks!

buy_big_3.ogg.text: [grinning] Now THAT is a gun. Everybody back up, big boy coming through!

buy_big_4.ogg.text: [laughs] Wallet's empty, but I've never felt so safe.

door_1.ogg.text: [grunts] Door's open! Watch the new angle!

door_2.ogg.text: Alright, that opens things up. Eyes front, people.

door_3.ogg.text: [wary] Okay... let's see what's behind door number one.

door_4.ogg.text: Door's open! More room to run, more room to get flanked.

door_5.ogg.text: [low] Easy now. Easy. Don't know what's in there.

power_on_1.ogg.text: [relieved] Yes! Lights are on! Power's back, baby!

power_on_2.ogg.text: [exhales] There she goes. Generator's humming again.

power_on_3.ogg.text: [laughs] Come on, come on, stay lit. I hate the dark.

power_on_4.ogg.text: Power's up! Keep her fed, or we're toast.

power_on_5.ogg.text: [chuckles] Nothing like a little light to cheer a guy up.

power_low_1.ogg.text: [worried] Generator's coughing! Somebody get it some fuel!

power_low_2.ogg.text: Uh-oh, the lights are flickering. Fuel, we need fuel!

power_low_3.ogg.text: [tense] If that thing dies, we're in the dark. Feed it, feed it!

power_low_4.ogg.text: [groans] Aw, no. Power's gone. Everybody stay close!

boss_arrive_1.ogg.text: [stunned, whispering] Oh no. Oh, that's big. That is really, really big.

boss_arrive_2.ogg.text: [shouting] Look at the size of that thing! Everybody focus fire, focus fire!

boss_arrive_3.ogg.text: [breathless] Okay, new plan. Run. Maybe run. No, shoot first, then run.

boss_arrive_4.ogg.text: [nervous laugh] You've gotta be kidding me. What do they feed that thing?

boss_arrive_5.ogg.text: [low, grim] Here's the big one. Stay together, and don't stop shooting.

boss_dead_1.ogg.text: [shouting, triumphant] Yeah! Go down! Go down, you big ugly... yes!

boss_dead_2.ogg.text: [panting, laughing] Is it dead? Tell me it's dead. Oh, thank God it's dead.

boss_dead_3.ogg.text: [breathless laugh] We did it! We actually did it! I can't believe that worked!

boss_dead_4.ogg.text: [exhaling] Whew. Okay. That one I'm gonna feel in the morning.

idle_1.ogg.text: [quiet, thoughtful] You ever think about how this place used to be a drive-in? People came to watch movies and eat popcorn. Now look at us.

idle_2.ogg.text: [sighs] Anyone else hear that? ...No? Just me. Great. I'm losing it.

idle_3.ogg.text: [tired] Sorry, I was humming. Habit. My mother used to hum when things got bad.

idle_4.ogg.text: [low] Man, what I wouldn't give for a hot coffee and a bed that doesn't smell like gasoline.

idle_5.ogg.text: [tired chuckle] Funny thing is, I used to hate quiet. Now it scares me more than the noise.
